data.name: Sangram T. Patil
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sangram T. Patil has made a big mark in cricket. With 16 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 32*, with an average of 14.55 and a quick strike rate of 125.98. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 9 sixes and 11 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 18.0 overs, taking 16 wickets at an economy rate of 7.78. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
